notes: The Playmaker: the bots got a brain. Every match the bot draws a secret game plan -- instant rushes, silent banking, pushes on both bridges at once. Overcommit a lane and it may ignore your push and slam the other one. Bots now spell your wounded towers, mine bridges with invisible Ambushes, dive through the gap when your tower falls, and go all-in in overtime. Three new opponents: the Trickster, the Charmer, and Siege. Still perfectly fair -- same elixir, same rules, no cheats.
